title: Verifying global identifiability of parametric linear ODE models is NP-hard
summary: Global parameter identifiability is a property of a parametric ODE model to recover the parameter values uniquely from the input-output data. Not all parametric ODE models have this property, and checking for parameter identifiability is a prerequisite to perform numerical parameter estimation. There are many algorithms and software packages for global parameter identifiability, and frequently the runtime is large.
